stage_1_screen.one_d_role: detached loss offset only; never a residual-head input
stage_1_screen.known_limit: The 1D vector is sample-wise OOF but not nested relative to the second-stage outer folds. Stage 1 is screening evidence only.
stage_1_screen.authorization_if_passed: Regenerate fold-pure 1D probabilities and repeat the fixed configuration formally.
stage_1_screen.authorization_if_failed: Stop; do not regenerate 1D folds, distill, refit all data, or inspect Test1/Test2.

stage_2_formal.required_1d_contract: For outer fold k, every 1D model used in residual fitting and evaluation must exclude fold k labels.

stage_3_distillation.allowed_association: same training peptide, paired single-conformer and multi-conformer views
stage_3_distillation.forbidden_association: direct test-to-training nearest-neighbor label or residual transfer

forbidden: Test1/Test2 labels or probabilities during training or selection
post-hoc loss-weight search after seeing OOF results
manuscript or canonical checkpoint modification before the final decision
